description: Implementation of a content file manager using Infinispan cache for managing static content files such as images, CSS, JS, PDFs, and videos for merchants. Provides methods for adding, retrieving, listing, and removing files within a cache structure.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Manages static content files (images, JS, CSS, PDFs, videos) for merchants using Infinispan cache, supporting add, retrieve, list, and delete operations.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a static content file (image, JS, CSS, etc.) for a specific merchant store into the cache.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store into the cache.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static content file for a merchant store from the cache.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all static content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file for a merchant store from the cache.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists all file names of a specific static content type for a merchant store.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager and releases resources.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the file manager instance.

methods.name: setRootName
methods.description: Sets the root name used as a prefix in cache node paths.

methods.name: getRootName
methods.description: Gets the current root name used in cache node paths.
